name: Jet Exhaust Rotating
description: This is part of a set of modular jet engine components. Thrust will be produced at the back of the exhaust proportional to the internal RPS of the engine. The direction of the thrust is controlled using a standard value that sets the target orientation within the pivot's range of motion of -0.5 to 0.5 turns.
shortDescription: A jet engine exhaust that has a built-in mechanical pivot.

logicNodes.label: Thrust Spoiler
logicNodes.description: The air flow spoiler for reducing effective thrust from the exhaust. Takes value 0 (no reduction in thrust) to 1 (total reduction in thrust).

logicNodes.label: Rotation Target
logicNodes.description: The standard value setting the orientation within the range of motion.

logicNodes.label: Air Pressure
logicNodes.description: The pressure of air into the exhaust.

logicNodes.label: Temperature
logicNodes.description: The temperature of air into the exhaust.

logicNodes.label: Electric
logicNodes.description: Electrical input to power the exhaust's pivot.
